name: Accelerator shipments
notes: Estimate. Accelerators shipped each year, worldwide including China, and the IT power they represent (units times power per accelerator, counted one quarter after shipment, IT taken as 85% of all-in power).

Power per accelerator is the maker's or industry figure where public and an Estimate otherwise (notably Rubin, Rubin Ultra, current TPUs, MI355 and MI400). AWS Trainium units are an Estimate from its power. Units are not estimated for Chinese chips, Microsoft Maia and smaller makers, so the units total excludes that group.
Shipments are not capacity energized: buyers typically power accelerators on 6 to 12 months after delivery. The likely-energized line is IT GW energized, excluding China.
